title: 용 세트 솔로 #019 · 터키·서양 용·혀 와인 보라·독니 금 캡+루비 · P50 · 배경 스튜디오 짙은 청록 · 기반 `la_facesculpt_080`
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the middle of her chest, her whole shoulders, collarbones and chest in view, the frame cutting off below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Late 20s.

Subject: A striking adult Turkish woman — Turkish elegant beauty with fair olive skin and real visible pores, late 20s, a sleek chin-length bob tucked behind both ears, a full makeup: a satin skin finish, defined lashes, groomed brows and a polished rosy lip, real western dragon eyes: oversized glossy fiery copper-orange irises about a third larger than a natural iris, covering most of the eye opening with only a thin rim of white showing at the corners, with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, jet black, running the full height of each eye, a faint ring of glowing ember-orange flecks around the pupil, both eyes the same, the colour solidly saturated across the whole iris with a darker ring around its edge, a wet glassy shine on the surface of each eye, set in her ordinary human eyelids and sitting clear of the eyelid edges, a fierce, intense stare — a photograph of a real Turkish woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her face is natural and beautiful: a long elegant face with a high forehead, a small nose with a soft tip and a defined cupid's bow. Face irezumi: a traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo in bold black ink outlines with vivid colour fills covers her forehead: a western dragon in forest green and bronze with black-edged scales, its wings half unfurled and fire curling from its jaws, its body winding across the whole forehead from one temple to the other, its head raised at the centre of the forehead above the brows; it is real tattooed skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible through the ink, the piercings, henna and stickers sit on top of the inked skin wherever they overlap, and her eyes and eyelids stay bare real skin. Eyeshadow: her eyeshadow is a snake-scale makeup in deep forest green, burnished bronze and copper, a smooth gradient across the whole eyelid from the lash line up to the brow bone, with a sharp, narrow, upswept winged liner in a black-bronze that ends in a long fine point at the outer corner and a faint shimmer of tiny scale-like glitter on the outer third of the lid; it sits on the lids as ordinary eyeshadow on her real skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible, and the eyeballs and lashes stay natural. Dragon horns: two thick, heavy, ridged dragon horns grow from the top corners of her forehead at the hairline, one above each temple, each horn rising upward and curving forward in a bold arc like the horn of a great western dragon and ending in a sharp point, each about as long as her hand, in burnished bronze with dark forest-green ridges running along its length; the base of each horn grows out of her real skin with a small natural ring of skin around it, and the two horns are the same, framing her face on either side of her head. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with one or two small natural beauty marks, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, real wet catchlights in the eyes and individual hair strands catching the light. Her skin is matte and natural, her forehead, nose and cheeks showing visible pores, fine skin texture and peach-fuzz with a soft, matte, dry-looking natural sheen, and the real skin around her brows, lips and the edges of her scales shows the same pores and texture. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while her eyeshadow is the animal-scale makeup described above): very large, perfectly round doll eyes, clearly bigger than normal but still a real human eye on a real face: a big visible iris , a darker limbal ring and a lighter coloured gradient at the bottom of the iris, long thick curled real lashes with a few lower lashes, and soft natural brows; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: an extreme, razor-sharp V-line: the cheeks taper in a long, smooth, straight diagonal from the ears down to a small, narrow, pointed chin, a very slim lower face with a sharply defined sculpted jaw edge. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her brows are a western dragon's heavy brow ridges: above each eye a thick raised ridge of overlapping dark forest-green scales with burnished bronze edges, topped by a row of small blunt spikes, follows the line of the brow and ends at the outer end in one short, curved bronze spike, so that each brow reads as a heavy scaled ridge in the shape of a natural brow, sitting on the brow bone below the forehead tattoo, with the real skin of her forehead and eyelids around it and the pores visible. Her cheeks: along each cheekbone grow three small, pointed bronze spikes in a row, each a little longer than the one before it and sweeping back toward her ear, the jawline and chin staying bare real skin. Her lips and mouth: her lips are a western dragon's lips, a row of small, smooth, glossy dark forest-green scales with fine burnished bronze edges covering the whole of both the upper lip and the lower lip from one corner of her mouth to the other and following the outline of each lip, so that her upper lip and her lower lip both read as scaled lips, and from each corner of her mouth a fine bronze line sweeps up and back in a sharp curve across the cheek, about as long as a thumb, like a long mouth line (this replaces any lip colour described above). Her lips are slightly parted and a real snake's tongue slides out through the gap between them and extends far out: an extremely thin, round, smooth cord as slim as a shoelace from its base to its tips, split from the tips back almost to its base into two hair-fine, needle-sharp prongs, each as fine as a thick strand of hair, held in a narrow V in the air and hanging well past her chin down to the base of her throat, deep wine-purple, glossy and wet-looking like a real snake's tongue, the whole thin tongue clearly visible against her skin and in sharp focus. Her lips part wide enough to show two long, slender, curved venomous fangs that descend from her upper jaw on either side of the centre, sheathed in polished gold from the gum up to just short of its ivory-white needle-sharp tip, a small round ruby set into the gold near the base of each fang, glossy and wet-looking, each as long as her lower lip is tall and tapering to a needle-sharp point, in sharp focus beside the tongue. Below her neck: everything from the base of her neck downward is a western dragon's skin instead of human skin, so that her whole body below the neck is covered like a real western dragon's body: both shoulders, both collarbones, the hollow between them, the centre of her chest and the whole upper chest, from one shoulder to the other and from the neck down to the bottom edge of the frame, are covered edge to edge in one continuous, unbroken layer of large, thick, keeled dragon scales in dark forest-green, each scale edged in burnished bronze and a little larger toward the shoulders, glossy like armour plates, running right across the middle of her chest in the same size and pattern as on the shoulders, each one clearly visible; the covered skin begins at a clean line around the base of her neck, while her face and neck stay real human skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible; her long thin tongue stands out clearly against it.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about forty in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; two small hoop or studs along the edge of the upper lip; four small hoop or studs across the lower lip's edge; two small ring or studs on the chin; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the upper opening holding a gigantic geometric chandelier earring, a large round O-ring hoop in the lobe with a pyramid of nested triangles, squares and hexagons hanging from it, a gemstone dangling from every corner, as wide as her palm and hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the lower opening holding one very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit seven pieces above the lobe: four classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, two studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and one in the conch and tragus; five small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; four small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are inspired by the sea: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are round pearl studs, tiny scallop-shell and starfish charms and rings strung with small coral beads. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. The ornate earring and the weights hang side by side from the two openings without touching or hiding each other. All the ear weights hang from the bottom of the lower iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly five separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear dull dark brass a hammer head on a shortest chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a short chain, dark patinated bronze a cube-shaped block on a medium chain, dull pewter-grey tin a miniature anvil on a long chain, dull blue-grey lead a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longer chain; on the right ear blackened cast iron a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a shortest chain, dull blue-grey lead a hammer head on a short chain, dull pewter-grey tin a pyramid-shaped lump on a medium chain, tarnished dark silver a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, oxidized dark copper a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longer chain. On each ear the lower iron ring carries its own column of 5 weights on chains of different lengths, staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between two openings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real pale gold and silver set with white pearls, mother-of-pearl and pink coral, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: A plain seamless deep teal backdrop, nothing else in frame, no texture, no gradient. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
